create_ParamHolder: create a ParamHolder module with a param shape and list of string keys
use_ParamHolder_to_idx: use ParamHolder to_idx method to convert string keys into tensor indices
use_ParamHolder_from_idx: use ParamHolder from_idx method to convert tensor indices back into string keys
use_to_device: use to_device to recursively move nested tensors and modules to a target device
use_index: use index to select elements from a tensor along a dimension using an index tensor
